declare function __Porffor_sproutboat_crc64_v1(state: Uint8Array, data: Uint8Array, offset: number, length: number): void;

// The compiler owns the versioned view validation and CRC boundary.
// Only the trusted restore build enables --sb-native-bytes-v1.
export function updateNativeCrc64(state: Uint8Array, data: Uint8Array): void {
  __Porffor_sproutboat_crc64_v1(state, data, 0, data.length);
}
